DayOff Mate (연차메이트)

DayOff Mate: request account and data deletion

App: DayOff Mate (연차메이트) · Package com.blessingq.dayoffmate · Developer: JAEYOUNG LEE (blessingq)

You can delete your DayOff Mate account and the data stored on our server directly in the app, or request it by email even without the app. If you never signed in, you have no account and your records exist only on your phone (see below). For now, even if you sign in, your records stay only on your phone and the server holds only what is needed to verify your account.

1. Delete in the app (fastest)

  1. Open DayOff Mate and go to Settings.
  2. Under Account, tap “Signed in with …” (for example, Signed in with Kakao).
  3. Tap Delete account (red) at the bottom.
  4. Tap [Delete] in the confirmation. Records saved on this phone stay as they are. To delete them too, use Settings › Data › Delete all records.

Deleting in the app also unlinks your Kakao or Google sign-in. Unlinking Google also removes the Google Drive auto-backup permission you gave with the same Google account. The app cannot unlink Naver, so after deleting, please unlink it yourself as the app explains (see the Naver item in section 2).

2. Request without the app

If you uninstalled the app or lost your phone, email us.

  • To: ejok9194@gmail.com
  • Subject: DayOff Mate account deletion request
  • Please include
    • Sign-in method: Kakao, Naver, Google or Apple
    • The email you signed in with (for Google or Apple)
    • Your nickname and ID (if set), group names (if any), and roughly when you signed up

We may ask for more information to verify it's you. We delete your account within 7 days of receiving the request and reply when it's done.

Please unlink your sign-in yourself

The developer cannot unlink Naver, whether you delete in the app or by email. For requests made without the app, the developer cannot unlink Google either. Your account data is still deleted; you can remove the connection here:

  • Google: Google Account > Security > Third-party apps & services > DayOff Mate > Delete connection
  • Naver: in the NAVER app, Settings > My info & security > History > Connected services, choose DayOff Mate and tap Withdraw consent. On the web, NAVER My info (nid.naver.com) > History > Connected services
  • Kakao: the developer unlinks it for you. To do it yourself, open Kakao Account (accounts.kakao.com), manage connected services and disconnect DayOff Mate

3. What is deleted

  • Sign-in information (provider identifier, email) and your DayOff Mate account
  • Records of age confirmation and of accepting the Terms and the Privacy Policy
  • Once record sync and groups launch (coming later), also
    • Leave settings stored on the server (hire date, leave basis, etc.), leave records and notes, day adjustments, settings
    • Nickname, ID, and sharing consent records
    • All group memberships, and the days off and remaining leave you shared with groups
    • Invitations sent and received, block list, notification settings, device push tokens

Once groups launch, groups you own pass to the member who joined earliest, and groups where you are the only member are deleted. Deletion cannot be undone.

4. What is kept, and for how long

Data kept after account deletion
DataRetention
Server access and error logs (some errors include the app user ID)Deleted automatically after 30 days
Kakao member number for retrying a failed Kakao unlinkDeleted once unlinking succeeds (up to 30 days)
Backups in Google Firebase's authentication systemUp to 180 days (Google policy)
Usage statistics (per-device, not linked to your account)Google Analytics retention period (up to 14 months)
Server backups for disaster recovery (planned)Up to 7 days
Group activity log (join/leave entries with your nickname), removal records (coming later)Deleted automatically within 30 days
Records kept as “deleted” markers (coming later)Deleted automatically within 30 days
Caches on other group members' phones (coming later)Briefly, until their app refreshes
Your deletion request email1 year after it is handled

No data currently has to be kept under other laws. Deleting your account in the app leaves the records saved on this phone as they are. Exported backup files, Google Drive auto-backups and events added to your phone calendar are in places you control, so deleting your account does not remove them (delete them as in section 5).

5. If you never signed in

You have no account and we have no records on our server. Your records exist only on your phone; delete them as follows:

  • In the app, Settings > Data > Delete all records, or uninstall the app.
  • If you turned on Google Drive auto-backup: backup files stay in your Google Drive. Delete them in Google Drive on the web: Settings > Manage apps > DayOff Mate > Options > Delete hidden app data, and remove access under Third-party apps & services.
  • If you added days off to your phone calendar: in the app, turn off Settings > Calendar > “Add days off to calendar” and choose “Remove from calendar”, or delete the “DayOff Mate” calendar in your calendar app.
  • Delete exported backup files from wherever you saved them.

6. Delete data but keep your account

  • One record: open it and tap “Delete this record”.
  • All records: Settings > Data > Delete all records (for now this deletes the records on this phone and your account stays; once record sync launches, records on the server and shared with groups are also deleted).
  • Group data (coming later): Group settings > Leave group; remove your ID on the account screen.
  • Usage statistics: turn off Settings > About > Send usage statistics.

See the Privacy Policy for details, or contact us with questions.
